title: 第13章 少看天山女侠转第14章 宋南烛 你欺负我
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
“我真傻，真的。”
沈无名坐在门槛边上，面前摆着一团水，不过这会儿已经变成了白色的面浆。
他就不该相信宋南烛这个暴力女人，一巴掌下去，面糊糊飞得到处都是。
非牛顿流体的确有遇强则强的属性，可也要看是面对谁呀。
宋南烛一巴掌能把马宝山拍飞，一脚能把那黑影人心脏都踹爆了。
她那股牛劲儿上来了，非牛顿流体哪挡得住，面糊糊溅得到处都是。
沈无名当时试图阻止，上前两步，结果全身上下都蒙上了一层面浆。
宋南烛坐在门槛的另一边，面前同样摆着一盆水，不断擦拭着身上的面糊糊。
“我也没有想到啊，谁让你不说清楚的？”宋南烛不满地撅了撅嘴。
她还不是受害者，要不是沈无名当时没讲清楚，至于搞成这样吗？
沈无名瞥了他一眼，不过目光却顿住瞬息，不得不说，涂满面糊糊的美丽面颊……
“妈的，又想歪了。”
沈无名决定惩罚自己，接下来三天不去看天山女侠传。
不过没多久，他又暗暗下定决心，还是六天吧，因为刚才又犯错了。
宋南烛为了擦拭身上的面糊糊，半个身子都打湿了，浸透了身上的衣服。
此时的湿身诱惑，隐约可见下方的景致风光，让沈无名一时间难以挪开目光。
平归平，但也有一股清纯的味道，纤细的腰肢，平坦的小腹。
还有那如同筷子一般笔直的双腿，被湿透的裤子紧贴着，充满无限遐想。
宋南烛初时未曾察觉，但旋即注意到沈无名半晌没有动作，顺着他的目光望去……
“你个流氓。”

宋南烛顿时大怒，抬手就打算朝沈无名轰过来。
但似乎又想到了自己的力气，反手抓起面前的盆子，朝着沈无名一泼！
“噗！”
……
“果然还是得多读书，少看天山女侠传，这玩意害人不浅啊……”
沈无名本来打算擦一擦身上就行了，结果被泼了水，只能好好洗个澡。
想到方才冒犯宋南烛的后果，不由得打了个寒颤，还得感谢她手下留情。
要不然的话，就自己这小身板，一脚就没了……下次还是离那个女人远点。
摇了摇头，沈无名见天色已经不早，干脆蒙着脑袋打算睡觉。
但就在这时，房外传来敲门声，沈无名打开一看，赫然就是自家娘子楚幼仪。
“娘子，这么晚了，有什么事吗？”
沈无名有些心虚地问道，不由得在暗自掂量，难不成是宋南烛告密了？
毕竟偷看自家娘子闺蜜这种事情，说出来的话，实在是丢人丢大发了。
楚幼仪温婉一笑，“白日里宾客众多，父亲便请了天盛酒楼的大厨来烧菜。”
“离开之前，还给我烧了一些零嘴，想着拿过来给夫君尝尝。”
说话间，楚幼仪抬起手展示了一下，沈无名这才注意到她提着一个食盒。
“这……”沈无名还没来得及说什么，楚幼仪便侧着身子踏进了他的房中。
双方这段时间关系和谐了不少，但楚幼仪也没有随便出入他的房间。
走进来一看，楚幼仪忍不住心头惊讶。
倒不是房中如何漂亮，而是干干净净，很是规整，没有一丝凌乱。

楚幼仪眼中闪过一抹异样，随即将食盒放在一旁，拿出一盘盘小菜。
content_en:
"I'm so stupid, really."
Shen Wuming sat on the edge of the threshold, with a ball of water in front of him, but it had turned into white batter at this time.
He shouldn't believe that Song Nanzhu, a violent woman, could make batter fly everywhere with just one slap.
Non-Newtonian fluids do have the property of becoming stronger when encountering strong ones, but it also depends on who they are dealing with.
Song Nanzhu could send Ma Baoshan flying with one slap, and break the heart of the shadow man with one kick.
Her strong energy came up, and the non-Newtonian fluid could not be blocked, and the batter splashed everywhere.
Shen Wuming tried to stop him and took two steps forward. As a result, his whole body was covered with a layer of batter.
Song Nanzhu sat on the other side of the threshold, also with a basin of water in front of him, constantly wiping the batter on his body.
"I didn't expect it either. Who told you not to explain clearly?" Song Nanzhu pouted dissatisfied.
She was not a victim yet. If Shen Wuming hadn't made it clear at the time, would it have ended up like this?
Shen Wuming glanced at him, but his eyes paused for a moment. It must be said that the beautiful cheeks covered with batter...
"Damn, I'm thinking wrong again."
Shen Wuming decided to punish himself and not watch The Legend of Tianshan Heroine for the next three days.
But not long after, he secretly made up his mind to keep it for six days, because he made another mistake just now.
In order to wipe the batter from his body, Song Nanzhu got half wet and soaked through his clothes.
The temptation of getting wet at this time, and the vague scenery below could be seen, making it difficult for Shen Wuming to look away for a while.
It's flat, but it also has a pure flavor, a slender waist, and a flat belly.
There are also those legs that are as straight as chopsticks, tightly clinging to the soaked pants, full of endless reverie.
Song Nanzhu didn't notice it at first, but soon noticed that Shen Wuming didn't move for a long time, and followed his gaze...
"You rascal."
Song Nanzhu was immediately furious and raised his hand to attack Shen Wuming.
But as if he thought of his own strength, he grabbed the basin in front of him with his backhand and splashed it towards Shen Wuming!
"Poof!"
…
"Sure enough, you should read more and watch less The Legend of Tianshan Heroine. This stuff is very harmful..."
Shen Wuming originally planned to just wipe his body, but he was splashed with water and had to take a good bath.
Thinking of the consequences of offending Song Nanzhu just now, I couldn't help but shudder, and I had to thank her for her mercy.
Otherwise, my small body would be gone in just one kick... I'd better stay away from that woman next time.
Shaking his head, Shen Wuming saw that it was already getting late, so he simply covered his head and planned to sleep.
But at this moment, there was a knock on the door outside the room. Shen Wuming opened it and saw that it was his wife, Chu Youyi.
"Madam, it's so late, what can I do?"
Shen Wuming asked with some guilt. He couldn't help but think secretly. Could it be that Song Nanzhu was the one who snitched?
After all, it would be really embarrassing to say something like peeking at your wife's best friend.
Chu Youyi smiled gently, "There were many guests during the day, so my father invited the chef from Tiansheng Restaurant to cook."
"Before I left, I burned some snacks for me. I thought I would give them to my husband to try."
While speaking, Chu Youyi raised her hand to show it, and Shen Wuming noticed that she was carrying a food box.
"This..." Before Shen Wuming could say anything, Chu Youyi stepped sideways into his room.
The relationship between the two parties has become much more harmonious during this period, but Chu Youyi did not enter or leave his room casually.
When she walked in and took a look, Chu Youyi couldn't help being surprised.
It's not that the room is beautiful, but it's clean, very orderly, and not messy at all.
Something strange flashed in Chu Youyi's eyes, then she put the food box aside and took out plates of side dishes.
